text:
maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we kept seeing the same 3 failure patterns (stale cross-region snapshots, DNS flip/flap during partial partitions, and cache-not-warmed on cutover). want a compact owners list + realistic timelines so we can close these before the next release. add yourself and any blockers. :spiral_calendar:

jonah: i'll take snapshot automation + retention policy. plan: add verification job that attempts a dry-restore in staging weekly and flags mismatched manifests. due 2026-04-05. blocking: need temporary increased test S3 quota.

rachel: i'll own restore runbook updates. action: reorder recovery steps, add explicit KV-cache warmup, include validation probes (read-after-write), and a rollback decision gate. PR target 2026-03-31. will include a short checklist for game day operators.

devon: routing + failover playbook here. i'll add healthcheck gating + SLO thresholds and an emergency manual cutover procedure. also propose a phased traffic ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 5m observation windows. target 2026-04-07.

priya: backups sweep in progress, found 2 manifests with header mismatch for eu1 snapshots. i'll run full integrity & push findings to the incident drive. ETA for fixes 2026-03-29.

ops-bot: created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/dr/1935554444/owners-checklist (auto). calendar: mini-game-day scheduled 2026-04-09 15:00-16:30 UTC. :white_check_mark:

maya: couple of nitpicks — please ensure runbook steps are idempotent and include exact CLI commands. rachel, add a `verify-state.sh` snippet that does: `curl write -> read -> diff` so oncall can binary-check data correctness.

rachel: good call. snippet i'll add: ```bash
# verify-state.sh
set -e
WRITE_ID=$(curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/internal/test -d '{"k":"x"}')
RESP=$(curl -s https://staging.api.redwood/internal/test/$WRITE_ID)
if [[ "$RESP" != "x" ]]; then
  echo \"state mismatch\"; exit 1
fi
echo \"ok\"
```

jonah: snapshot verification job will post results to `/incidents/dr-2026-03/backup-verification/` and create an alert if any quick-diff fails. i'll open the infra PR and ping @maya.

devon: terraform snippet for weighted DNS I will add to the doc, sample: ```hcl
resource "aws_route53_record" "api" {
  zone_id = aws_route53_zone.main.zone_id
  name    = "api.redwood.com"
  type    = "A"
  weighted_routing_policy {
    weight = 70
  }
}
```

priya: note from backups sweep: some snapshots in ap-south were missing manifest entries for incremental chain. i've quarantined affected snapshots and flagged retention policy gap. will propose policy change in PR.

maya: short owners summary — reply with :white_check_mark: when you start work and paste PR/ calendar links in thread: 
- restore runbook + verify script — rachel — due 2026-03-31
- backup verification + manifests fix — priya — due 2026-03-29
- snapshot automation & dry-restore job — jonah — due 2026-04-05
- weighted DNS & failover ramp doc — devon — due 2026-04-07
- mini-game-day rehearsal (90m) — ops-bot/scheduling — 2026-04-09 15:00 UTC

jonah: started. infra PR: https://redwood.internal/pr/5678 (draft).

rachel: started. runbook PR: https://redwood.internal/pr/5682 (WIP). added verify-state.sh.

devon: draft DNS doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/failover/dns-weighted (will add terraform).

priya: started backup fixes, logs at `s3://incidents/dr-2026-03/backup-logs/` and drive at `/incidents/dr-2026-03/backup-verification/`.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: weekly owner-check every Monday 09:00 UTC starting 2026-03-30.

maya: thanks folks. i'll maintain the tracker spreadsheet and escalate any blockers. let's make sure the rehearsal uses a staged canary and we practice rollback too. closing this thread for new items; re-open if something changes. :lock:
